name: anthropic-system-blocks-markdown-section
description: Anthropic system given as text blocks. The "## Context" markdown section runs to the next heading of the same level ("## Rules") and becomes one request_system item (heading line excluded). The "## Rules" section is not an evidence heading, so it stays in system_instructions.

system.text:
You are a billing assistant.

## Context

Late fees are 2% per month.

## Rules
Never promise a waiver.
